## About
Bartley Service Co. is a family owned and operated business that has served the Austin area with a full array of truck and auto repair services. When we say we do it all, we mean it.
We work on cars and medium-duty trucks, and we also do hydraulic repair and assembly, plus welding and fabrication. We never skimp on quality. We make sure each job is done right and done well the first time around.
We love what we do. Give us a call or stop by the shop in Pflugerville, Monday through Friday.

## Services
- Truck and Auto Mechanic Repair: Mechanic repair for cars and trucks, from everyday problems to bigger jobs.
- Hydraulic Sales and Service: Hydraulic pump repair, cylinder repair, custom-designed cylinders, parts and assembly.
- Welding and Fabrication: Welding and fabrication work, including custom welding.
- Custom Hose Assembly: Hydraulic hose assembly with fittings, adapters, accessories and Parkrimp crimping.
- Air Conditioning Service: Air conditioning service for cars and medium-duty trucks.
- Alignment and Front End: Alignment and front end work for cars and medium-duty trucks.
- Electrical Starters, Alternators and Switches: Electrical repair on starters, alternators and switches.
- Lubrication and Oil Changes: Routine lubrication and oil changes to keep your vehicle running.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on regular cars or just trucks?
A: Both. We offer automotive repair services for all cars and medium-duty trucks.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We're in Pflugerville and serve all of metropolitan Austin.

Q: What tire brands do you carry?
A: We offer Bridgestone and Firestone tires.

Q: How do I get more information about a job?
A: Call or e-mail us about your car, truck or hydraulic work. We look forward to helping you.
